اظطلمت (form VIII)
# اِظْطَلَمْتُ (iẓṭalamtu) /iðˤ.tˤa.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# اِظْطَلَمْتَ (iẓṭalamta) /iðˤ.tˤa.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# اِظْطَلَمْتِ (iẓṭalamti) /iðˤ.tˤa.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# اِظْطَلَمَتْ (iẓṭalamat) /iðˤ.tˤa.la.mat/: thi
